title: Manyhands JSON v1 ticket plan
description: Open tickets in batches that can each be worked at once, and the open tickets that closing tickets can never reach. Batches are in batch order and their tickets, like the unplannable ones, in ID order. A batch keeps the number it has in the plan of every ticket, and a batch a filter left empty is not listed.

complete.description: False when the last refresh could not read, or stopped part of the way through, .manyhands/tickets or .manyhands. Tickets may then be missing from what this was made from while index.state is current.
